clue.text: Possibly one prude's final significant error

indicators.note: possibly suggests the letters that follow could be arranged some other way

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
the possessive s counts as a letter here
taken as written

explanation.surface: A prim person's last mistake turns out to be a revealing one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Possibly' shuffles I (one), PRUDES and FINAL; the possessive's S is needed as a letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A slip of the tongue thought to reveal hidden desires is a telling, meaningful mistake.

clue.text: Flighty young woman once — one inclined to panic

definitions.meaning: a fashionable, carefree young woman of the 1920s
someone who gets in a flap, easily flustered

explanation.definitionFit: The word names a twenties good-time girl and, playfully, a person given to agitation.

clue.text: Provide section of Beethoven duet

indicators.note: section of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Someone supplies part of a piece by Beethoven for two players.
explanation.definitionFit: To endue is to endow or furnish someone with a quality.

clue.text: Book found in cathedral around beginning of last month

indicators.note: around says the Italian cathedral wraps round the date

parts.note: a duomo is an Italian cathedral
the first day of December, written as Dec plus Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A volume is discovered in a cathedral early last month.
explanation.walkthrough: The first of the year's last month is written DEC I, Dec with Roman one; that goes inside DUOMO.
explanation.definitionFit: A duodecimo is a book size made from sheets folded into twelve leaves.

clue.text: Wear away a woven fabric, say

indicators.note: say signals that the phrase is to be heard rather than read

parts.note: a braid is a woven band of threads

explanation.surface: A woven cloth is said to wear thin.
explanation.definitionFit: To abrade is to scrape or erode a surface by friction.

clue.text: By arresting learner, supports police officer in fine style

indicators.note: in a down clue the piece that supports another sits below it

parts.note: super is short for superintendent, a police rank

indicators.note: arresting says the word By holds the learner inside

parts.note: L is a learner, from the British L-plate

explanation.surface: A senior policeman, nabbing a novice driver, acts with great flair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arresting' sounds like police work but is the container signal, and 'supports' puts BLY under SUPER in the down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Superbly means excellently, with great skill.

clue.text: Lazy son dropped from supplement

indicators.note: dropped from says the abbreviation is taken out of the word that follows

parts.note: an insert is a supplement slipped into a magazine

explanation.surface: An idle son is dropped from the paper's extra section.
explanation.definitionFit: Inert means sluggish, inactive, without energy.

clue.text: Sophisticated girl coming out and broadcasting

parts.note: a deb, or debutante, is a girl coming out into society
on air means being broadcast

explanation.surface: A debutante makes her social debut while appearing on radio.
explanation.definitionFit: Debonair means suave and urbane.

clue.text: Short run for band, not a regular one

definitions.meaning: a brief spell, like a winning run, or a quick naked dash
an irregular stripe or line of colour

explanation.definitionFit: The word covers a short series of wins and an uneven stripe of colour.

clue.text: Sound reproduction I employed in a posh function

parts.note: U stands for upper-class, hence posh

indicators.note: employed in says the letter is put to work inside the phrase that follows

parts.note: a do is a party or social function

explanation.surface: Someone describes the sound system they used at a smart party.
explanation.walkthrough: U as 'upper-class' or posh is a British convention; I goes inside A U DO, between D and O.
explanation.definitionFit: Audio is the technical term for recorded or transmitted sound, as opposed to vision.

clue.text: Act for theatre company freshly directed?

parts.note: rep is short for repertory, a theatre company staging a run of plays
re-sent means directed (addressed and sent) again, freshly

explanation.surface: A theatre troupe's production is staged under new direction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'directed' poses as stage direction but means a letter addressed and dispatched; RESENT is split as RE-SENT, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: To represent someone is to stand in or speak on their behalf.

clue.text: He has cherished aim, right to be accepted king

definitions.text: He has cherished aim, right to be accepted king

indicators.note: to be accepted says the letter is taken in by the word before it

parts.note: a pet is a cherished favourite
an end is a goal or aim
ER can stand for Edward Rex, King Edward

explanation.surface: A man nurses the ambition of being acknowledged as rightful monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'He has' only joins; read whole, the clue also describes a claimant hoping to be recognised as monarch. ER as a king is Edward Rex, rarer than the queen's ER.
explanation.definitionFit: A claimant to a throne cherishes the aim of having his title to the crown recognised.

clue.text: Time to wander about finding hidden valuables

parts.note: to rove is to wander about

explanation.surface: A treasure hunter takes time to roam around and finds buried riches.
explanation.definitionFit: A trove is a hoard of treasure found hidden away, as in treasure trove.

clue.text: Game lodge not quite finished in the country

parts.note: RU is rugby union, a game

indicators.note: not quite finished says the last letter of the word for lodge is dropped

parts.note: to lodge is to stick fast

explanation.surface: A hunting lodge out in the countryside has not been completely built.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Game lodge' reads as one hunting cabin, but splits into RU (rugby union) and a verb meaning stick.
explanation.definitionFit: Rustic describes what belongs to rural life, away from towns.

clue.text: A piece of music taken up by Chopin's friend for dance

indicators.note: taken by says the inner pieces are held by the name that follows

parts.note: George Sand, the novelist, was Chopin's lover

indicators.note: up in a down clue says the word is read from the bottom

parts.note: a bar is a short section of music

explanation.surface: A musical extract is adopted by the composer's companion as a dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taken' signals the container and 'up' turns the music piece upwards in this down entry; George Sand was the pen name of the French novelist Aurore Dupin.
explanation.definitionFit: A saraband is a slow stately Spanish dance in triple time.

clue.text: Cake a sailor put on the tab

indicators.note: put on in an across clue means placed after the other piece

parts.note: a flap is a tab of material
a jack, or jack tar, is a sailor

explanation.surface: A seaman runs up a bill for a cake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put on the tab' suggests buying on credit, but 'tab' is a flap of material and 'put on' places the sailor after it.
explanation.definitionFit: A flapjack is a British oat-and-syrup bar baked as a tray cake.

clue.text: Soviet executive, mostly civil, raised old difficulty

indicators.note: mostly says the word for civil loses its final letter

parts.note: civil means polite

indicators.note: raised in a down clue says the pieces are read upwards

parts.note: a rub is a difficulty, as in Hamlet's there's the rub

explanation.surface: A Soviet official, fairly courteous, brought up an old problem.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' turns O plus RUB into BURO.
explanation.definitionFit: The Politburo was the chief policy-making committee of the Soviet Communist Party.

clue.text: An aid to visibility for touching down

definitions.meaning: landing, as a bird alights on a branch

explanation.definitionFit: The word means illumination and also settling or landing, from the verb light on.

clue.text: Vehicle with unpleasant smell left one cold — disinfectant's the solution

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
BO is body odour
one is the Roman numeral I
C is the abbreviation for cold on taps

explanation.surface: A smelly car leaves someone chilled, so disinfectant is called for.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disinfectant's the solution' doubles as a pun: carbolic was used as a solution in water.
explanation.definitionFit: Carbolic acid, or phenol, was the classic antiseptic used to kill germs.

clue.text: One sometimes caught in row through being bad-tempered

parts.note: rowers catch a crab when an oar blade jams in the water
by means through, by means of

explanation.surface: A rower is irritable after a mishap in a race.
explanation.walkthrough: To 'catch a crab' in rowing is to fumble a stroke; 'being' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: Crabby means irritable and grumpy.

clue.text: Unorthodox circle for a priest to move in

indicators.note: unorthodox suggests the letters of the next word are set out in an unconventional order

explanation.surface: A clergyman joins an unconventional social set.
explanation.walkthrough: CIRCLE is rearranged; 'for a', 'to move in' merely link the idea of a circle a churchman moves in.
explanation.definitionFit: A cleric is a member of the clergy, such as a minister or vicar.

clue.text: In church, has inclination to absolve from sin

indicators.note: In says the word for inclination goes inside the abbreviation for the church

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
leans means has an inclination

explanation.surface: A churchgoer is inclined to forgive sins.
explanation.definitionFit: To cleanse a soul is to purify it of wrongdoing.

clue.text: Dedicated person departed after broadcast

indicators.note: after says the word for departed follows the broadcast piece

parts.note: OB is an outside broadcast
late means dead, departed

explanation.surface: Someone left after a programme went out.
explanation.definitionFit: An oblate is a layperson dedicated to a monastic community.

clue.text: Record of poor quality produced by a learner

indicators.note: produced by puts the shoddy piece after the earlier pieces

parts.note: L is a learner, from the L-plate on a British learner's car
bum is slang for worthless or of poor quality

explanation.surface: A novice turns out a shoddy recording.
explanation.definitionFit: An album is a long-playing record, a collection of tracks.

clue.text: Virile eccentric going over house

indicators.note: going over in a down clue says the word is turned upwards

parts.note: a cam is an eccentric wheel in machinery

explanation.surface: A tough, manly oddball heads over to a house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'eccentric' looks like an oddball but is a cam, an off-centre wheel; turned upward it gives MAC.
explanation.definitionFit: Macho means aggressively masculine.

clue.text: It's healthy around part upper classes considered okay to live in

indicators.note: around says the word for healthy is wrapped round the next pieces

parts.note: hale means healthy
a bit is a part
A and B are the top grades in the British social classification

explanation.surface: Wealthy people judge a wholesome neighbourhood a decent place to reside.
explanation.walkthrough: A and B are the top bands in the UK's social-grade scale. 'It's' and 'considered' just link.
explanation.definitionFit: A habitable place is fit for occupation as a dwelling.

clue.text: Good movement could make this person start afresh

indicators.note: movement says one letter shifts to another spot in the word

parts.note: begin means start, set out anew

explanation.surface: Doing a good deed might let someone make a new start.
explanation.walkthrough: Shifting G in BEGIN gives the answer; 'could make this' links.
explanation.definitionFit: A being is a living creature, an individual.

clue.text: Scholar taking in single feature of porcelain

indicators.note: taking in says the degree holder holds the next pieces inside

parts.note: a BA, Bachelor of Arts, is a graduate scholar
one means single
the chin is a facial feature

explanation.surface: An academic focuses on one distinctive aspect of ceramics.
explanation.definitionFit: Bone china is fine translucent porcelain made with bone ash.

clue.text: University operating student organisation

parts.note: on means working or operating

explanation.surface: A college runs a society for its students.
explanation.definitionFit: The students' union represents students and runs their facilities.

clue.text: Blues in Mondrian's Broadway painting

definitions.meaning: a fast piano style built on the twelve-bar blues
Broadway ... is Mondrian's 1943 grid painting of New York

explanation.definitionFit: The piano blues style gave its name to Mondrian's jazzy late painting of Manhattan.
